name: Did not finish
description: Took the start but retired and was not classified

name: Not classified
description: Took the start and was running at the end but did not complete enough laps to be classified

name: Disqualified
description: Took the start but was disqualified from the race

name: Did not start
description: Took part in the weekend (practice or qualifying) but did not take the start

name: Did not qualify
description: Took part in qualifying but did not get a place on the grid

name: Did not pre-qualify
description: Took part in pre-qualifying but did not get through to qualifying

name: Excluded
description: Was excluded from the event before the race

name: Did not practice
description: Was at the event but did not take part in any session

name: Withdrawn
description: Was entered but withdrew before or during the event (it includes the drivers replaced after practice)

name: Did not arrive
description: Was entered but did not arrive at the event

name: Test driver
description: Only took part in free practice as a third or test driver. Calculated by the API: it is never stored in the race results
